versions.content: If configuration parameter DemResetConfirmedBitOnOver- flow is set to false and an event memory entry aging occurs the Dem module shall check for other events having UDS status bit 3 set to 1 and UDS status bit 0 set to 0. If such an event is found, the Dem shall allocate an event memory location to get an aging counter .
